messages:
linh: I opened a docs PR to refresh the FreshStart tutorial (hello/minimal app). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — main problems I found: outdated env var names for tokens, Node/TS sample uses old SDK call shape, and the Dockerfile example references PORT=8080 while the quickstart uses 3000. Can folks smoke-test the snippets?

samira: looking now. quick scan — README still references 'REDWOOD_API_KEY' which we deprecated. Should be 'REDWOOD_TOKEN'.

aj: I can run the node & py snippets this afternoon. Which branch?

linh: branch is docs/freshstart-tokens. I'll paste the corrected snippets here in a sec.

linh: export snippet for mac/linux: `export REDWOOD_TOKEN="$TOKEN"`  (windows: `setx REDWOOD_TOKEN "..."`)  — also added a note about avoiding hardcoding tokens.

chris: tiny nit — the Node sample uses `sdk.v1.generate(...)` in the file. For SDK v3 our docs should show `client.responses.create(...)`.

samira: running a local Docker build now to verify port & env behavior. FYI CI lint will fail until the auth doc link is updated.

deploy-bot: build queued for docs/freshstart-tokens #412 — status: queued

aj: local test: Node sample works after switching to REDWOOD_TOKEN. Python sample failed initially: requirements.txt pins `redwood-sdk==1.2.0`.

linh: fixed requirements to `redwood-sdk>=3.0.0` and pushed. Also updated the TypeScript snippet to show the new client constructor.

chris: LGTM besides one more link: README points to `/quickstart/old-auth` — needs a redirect to `/docs/auth/token` or update the link directly.

samira: I'll open a tiny redirect PR post-merge. Approving the content changes here, will re-check after the site deploys.

linh: thanks all. I'll merge once CI is green. @samira @aj please verify the live doc after the deploy and leave any followups in this thread. :rocket:

linh: updated TS example inline for clarity:
```ts
import { Redwood } from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })
await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'hello' })
```

deploy-bot: build started for docs/freshstart-tokens #412 — status: running

linh: merged and will watch the deploy. last check-in here at 2312345705
